In the main Llama-3-Instruct (8B) results, **SimPO gets 33.8% and DPO gets 32.6%** on Arena-Hard, so SimPO leads by 1.2 points (Table 4, page 6).

| Method | Arena-Hard WR | 95% CI (low–high) | Avg. length |
|---|---|---|---|
| SimPO | 33.8% | 32.0–35.9 | 504 |
| DPO | 32.6% | 30.3–34.8 | 528 |

The confidence intervals and lengths come from Table 10 (page 25). The intervals overlap.

The paper also has an updated "v0.2" version of this setting, where a stronger reward model (ArmoRM) labels the preference data. There, SimPO gets 36.5% and DPO gets 35.2% (Table 12, page 29). The authors note that with a strong SFT model and better data, the differences between methods shrink on Arena-Hard (page 30).
